result.rationale: The migration does `execute("...WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'...")[0]['id'].to_i` with no nil guard. On fresh installs (or sites that never set embed_category), no such row exists, so `[0]` is nil and `['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting db:migrate before the `if category_id == 0` fallback runs. The code plainly indexes `[0]['id']` directly, confirming the mechanism.

judged_text: The migration reads site_settings rows with no guard for absence, so `execute(...WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'...)[0]['id'].to_i` raises NoMethodError on nil whenever no embed_category site_settings row exists — every fresh install and every site that never overrode that setting — aborting db:migrate before the `if category_id == 0` fallback can ever run. Fresh installs and all sites that never set embed_category fail db:migrate at this migration, blocking every upgrade containing this commit until the SQL is patched by hand.
